shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace; for f in pages/*.js pages/*/*.js pages/api/*/*.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version"
cd /workspace; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_retry\|not-found" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -150; echo ======; grep -n -i "metadata\|global-not-found\|## " 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head -40; ls 02-guides | grep -i migrat; ls 02-guides/migrating 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && mkdir -p app/blog/\[id\] app/api/posts/\[id\] lib && git rm -rq pages components/AppProvider.js && ls
npx next typegen >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4
for u in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/50 /blog/99999 /nope; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3123$u) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html | head -1)"; done
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Your user agent: [^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*' ; curl -s -A test-ua localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'test-ua'
curl -s localhost:3123/api/posts; echo
curl -s -XPOST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a","content":"b"}' -w ' %{http_code}' localhost:3123/api/posts; echo
curl -s -XPOST -w ' %{http_code}' localhost:3123/api/posts; echo
curl -s localhost:3123/api/posts/3; echo
curl -s -XPUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"x"}' localhost:3123/api/posts/3; echo
curl -s -XDELETE localhost:3123/api/posts/3; echo
curl -s -i -XPATCH localhost:3123/api/posts/3 | head -5
pkill -f "next start"
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short; ls pages 2>&1

cd /workspace; printf '.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
' >> .gitignore; cat .gitignore; git status --short | grep '??'
